race.comment: AUTUMN HEIR (2) improved significantly last start at the second run of his campaign, bursting on the scene late only to miss by 0.6 lengths over 1750m at Muswellbrook. Filled a placing at his only try over today's trip. This appeals as a perfect third-up assignment. DUNDEE TALES (6) hasn't won for 61 weeks but his last two runs have been encouraging. Stepped up to today's trip at Coffs Harbour last time out and closed off well to get up for second in a Class 1. Enjoys a soft run from the inside alley and looks sure to be in the finish again. FARRAIGE (3) backs up five days after a moderate fourth over the mile at Goulburn, his first run in a month. Goes well here and 2000m is a far more suitable journey. Likely improver. IN ISO (5) has been struggling at the provincials. Sure to appreciate this drop in grade although his strike rate is horrendous. D'ORO CHOICE (1) is coming along nicely this prep and comes back a level this afternoon. Should be ready to peak.
